decision: Thirty-five scoped current interpretations: 23 existing papers receive narrow administrative authority completion; eight substantial C28 current versions incorporate33 per-instance Kazuma references; two C18 current interpretations distinguish preserved experiment cores from later dependent diagnostics; two C20 current versions apply C20-CR04. All12 original public papers and all private foundations remain exact. No model, grade or maturity promotion follows.
authority_and_freeze_decision: Routing8.2 distinguishes historical experiment/publication pins from explicit byte locks. Twenty-three existing papers receive only administrative current derivatives, with every analytical byte retained. Twelve separate substantial current versions preserve their original public papers and private foundations exactly: eight with per-instance C28 reference corrections, two under the C18 explicit every-listed-byte seal, and two under the C20 explicit five-core seal. Every original tested model, rule, input, first response and score remains exact. Current versions neither repair historical tests nor acquire independent performance credit.
